## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Content or balance change
- [ ] UI polish
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Checked manually in the browser
- [ ] Checked fresh save behavior when relevant
- [ ] Checked existing/imported save behavior when relevant

## Notes for Reviewers

Mention balance risks, save compatibility risks, follow-up work, or screenshots when useful.
